title: Setup tip #1: Wheelbase
captions:
SETUP TIP #1: WHEELBASE 🔧

⬅️ SHORTER: more rotation. The kart pivots more easily through corners.
➡️ LONGER: less rotation. More stable, but harder to rotate.

Every setup change is explained like this in the Kart Connect Setup Reference, and every change you make is logged against the session, so you can see what it did to your lap time. 🏁

Save this for your next test day. 📌

title: Setup tip #2: Caster
captions:
SETUP TIP #2: CASTER 🔧

⬆️ MORE: quicker rotation and more inside rear lift on turn-in. The first fix for understeer or poor turn-in.
⬇️ LESS: the kart sits flatter with less rotation. More stable, but harder to turn in.

Find every setup change explained in the Kart Connect Setup Reference, and log every change you make so you know what worked. 🏁

title: Setup tip #3: Rim type
captions:
SETUP TIP #3: RIM TYPE 🔧❄️

The temperature's dropping, so this one matters.

☀️ SUMMER / HARD: controls tyre pressures and keeps the tyre cooler. Better in warm conditions.
❄️ WINTER / SOFT: warms the tyre quicker but drops off sooner. Better in cold conditions.

Log which rims you ran in Kart Connect, alongside the live weather, and you'll know exactly what works when it's cold. 🏁

Save this for winter testing. 📌

🔗 kart-connect.com

#KartConnect #Karting #KartSetup #KartTips #WinterTesting

Cold out? Think about your rims. ❄️

Winter / soft warms the tyre quicker. Summer / hard keeps it cooler.
